anomalies.observed: NFC SDA (U4 pin 5) is routed via NET0010 to U1 pin 41 (PA8); NFC SCL (U4 pin 3) is routed via NET0011 to U1 pin 23 (PA7).
anomalies.expected: NFC SDA should connect to the MCU's PB9 (pin 62) and NFC SCL to PB8 (pin 61), as specified.

evidence.quote: NFC_SDA net: U2 pin 62 (PB9) — R1 (10 kΩ) to VCC — U3 pin 5 (SDA)
NFC_SCL net: U2 pin 61 (PB8) — R2 (10 kΩ) to VCC — U3 pin 3 (SCL)
Root sheet: NFC_IC hierarchical pin NET0010 wires to U1 pin 41 (PA8); NFC_IC hierarchical pin NET0011 wires to U1 pin 23 (PA7).

anomalies.impact: The NFC I2C bus is wired to PA7/PA8 instead of PB8/PB9. Firmware expecting the specified I2C pins will not communicate with the NT3H2111, making NFC non-functional.

anomalies.observed: NET0015 (connected to the 22 nF sampling capacitor C19) is wired to U1 pin 57 (PB5); NET0009 (connected through the 1 kΩ series resistor R14 to the touch electrode BTN) is wired to U1 pin 59 (PB7).
anomalies.expected: TSC_G2_IO2 (PB5, pin 57) should connect to the touch electrode through a 1 kΩ series resistor, and TSC_G2_IO4 (PB7, pin 59) should connect to the 22 nF sampling capacitor to GND.

evidence.quote: TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin "BTN" (the touch electrode)
TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND) — this is the TSC sampling capacitor for the group
Root sheet: Touch block label NET0015 wires to U1 pin 57 (PB5); touch block label NET0009 wires to U1 pin 59 (PB7).

anomalies.impact: The STM32 TSC peripheral requires the sampling capacitor on the last IO of the group (G2_IO4, PB7). With the electrode and sampling capacitor swapped, the touch sensing controller will not acquire correctly, so the capacitive touch button will not work.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains two functional wiring deviations from the specification: the NFC I2C bus is connected to PA7/PA8 instead of PB8/PB9, and the capacitive touch electrode and sampling capacitor are swapped between PB5 and PB7. Both would prevent the corresponding subsystems from working as intended.
